description: Perth Metro (LGATE-323) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This imagery service provides Perth metropolitan aerial imagery as individual layers from 1947 through to present day. To improve performance and address recurring issues, the Perth Metro service is now split into two discrete services - aerial captures that occurred a) pre 2010 and b) 2010 onwards. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are Metropolitan Perth, Perth, Perth Metro, Perth aerial mosaic, Perth and environs. It offers 5 resource(s) in esri rest, esri rest - token, pdf, wms. The portal shows 2025-09-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
